EXECUTIVE SUMMARY CVSS v4 8.7 ATTENTION : Exploitable remotely/low attack complexity Vendor : MOBOTIX Equipment : P3 Cameras, Mx6 Cameras Vulnerability : Improper Neutralization of Expression/Command Delimiters 2. RISK EVALUATION Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow an authenticated attacker to achieve remote code execution. 3.
